name: Ľudovít Ódor - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the feasibility of a 28th tax regime and its potential to support EU competitiveness
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

The European Parliament says the EU should create an optional new set of company rules, called the 28th regime, that companies could choose instead of national rules. It wants a tax part added later, so companies can use one tax base, one VAT number and simpler rules when they work across borders. It says tax rates would stay with national governments. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law by itself.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for a voluntary EU-wide company and tax framework, with tax rates still set by each country.
- **Who it affects:** Start-ups, small and medium companies and growing firms that want to operate in several EU countries.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and EU governments decide whether to propose and approve such rules.
